title: OVIG: Optimistic Verification of AI Training Integrity via Gradient Signals
abstract: arXiv:2606.21045v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The rapid growth of AI has increased the demand for domain-specific models. Post-training of open-source models offers a more economical way to meet this growing demand, but the cost of accelerator infrastructure often pushes organizations to outsource the process to third-party providers. An untrusted provider may deviate from the declared training procedure to save computation or inject malicious behavior. A potential solution is to audit the training by having an independent verifier replay the training and compare the results. This faces two key challenges: benign numerical drift from floating-point computation across heterogeneous accelerators is difficult to distinguish from malicious deviations, and the checkpoints and metadata required for verification introduce substantial storage and transmission costs. translated_title: OVIG：基于梯度信号的AI训练完整性的乐观验证
translated_abstract: 人工智能的快速发展增加了对领域专用模型的需求。对开源模型进行后训练为满足这一日益增长的需求提供了一种更经济的方式，但加速器基础设施的高昂成本往往促使组织将这一过程外包给第三方提供商。不可信的提供商可能会偏离声明的训练流程以节省计算资源或注入恶意行为。一种潜在的解决方案是让独立的验证者重放训练过程并比较结果，从而审计训练的完整性。然而这面临两个关键挑战：来自异构加速器上浮点计算的良性数值漂移难以与恶意偏差区分开，且验证所需的检查点和元数据会带来巨大的存储和传输成本。现有方法要么存在安全局限性，要么部署成本高昂。我们提出了OVIG，一种乐观验证方法……
tldr: 提出了OVIG，一种利用梯度信号对AI训练完整性进行乐观验证的方法，能够区分良性数值漂移与恶意偏差，同时降低检查点存储和传输的高昂成本。
en_tdlr: OVIG is an optimistic verification approach for AI training integrity that leverages gradient signals to distinguish benign numerical drift from malicious deviations while reducing the substantial storage and transmission costs of checkpoints and metadata.
